doc: The DISCH sidecar of M3 (holon.analysis.closure, rules D1-D10; holon.disch.run), written for the blind rerun from code alone. documents: the Rollup transitions document. r0: the deployment's abstraction, from what the target's constructor and initializer write at deployment (below). hypotheses and hypothesis_verdicts: none, since the target code states no hypothesis about its external components. binding: the configuration-only binding spec, whose deployment record holon binding derives by forge. search: the budget of spec/M3/lib/disch.json at the pack commit, as the blind-rerun brief gives it.

r0.doc: The Rollup runs behind a proxy, so its constructor (LAYER_2_CHAIN_ID, an immutable, and _disableInitializers on the implementation's own storage) writes none of the proxy's register paths. initialize (modifier initializer) writes _initialized 1 and leaves _initializing false; __Pausable_init writes _paused false; __Ownable_init writes _owner the caller; then submitterContract, messageQueue, verifier, finalizationPeriodSeconds, proofWindow and proofRewardPercent take its arguments. An argument or the caller is any word (T); every other path is 0.
